title: What Is a Recession, Really?
description:
Two quarters of falling GDP is a common rule of thumb, not an official definition everywhere. In the US, the NBER committee weighs jobs, income, spending and output, often confirming recessions months later.

Sources:
• IMF: Recession, back to basics: https://www.imf.org/external/pubs/ft/fandd/basics/recess.htm
• NBER: Business cycle dating: https://www.nber.org/research/business-cycle-dating
